standard_prerequisites.name: Eilenberg swindle: if F_0 = P plus Q is free then P plus a countable direct sum of copies of F_0 is isomorphic to that countable direct sum
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the final isomorphism P plus F is isomorphic to F.

core_obligations: Projectivity of P gives a module Q with F_0 = P plus Q free (proof lines 39002-39004). Set F = the direct sum over n >= 1 of copies of F_0 (proof lines 39004-39005). By the Eilenberg swindle, P plus F is isomorphic to F, which is free, so P plus F is free (proof lines 39005-39006).
proof_roadmap: Use projectivity to write F_0 = P plus Q free (proof lines 39002-39004).
Add countably many copies of F_0 and apply the Eilenberg swindle (proof lines 39004-39006).
difficulty_reason: 5 行、投射模加自由模补成自由模：投射性给出 F_0 = P ⊕ Q 自由；取 F = ⊕_{n≥1} F_0；Eilenberg swindle 引理给出 P ⊕ F ≅ F，故 P ⊕ F 自由。承重两步（投射性拆分、swindle 同构）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
